name: Cockrell Hill
requestOutcomes: See city record requestsAndEndpointChecks. Official DCAD and City of Dallas ArcGIS metadata returned HTTP 200, and bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry queries returned one polygon each at the preserved WUP point. The Texas Geographic Information Office bounded query returned HTTP 400 unsupported operation and was not treated as a negative source finding.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:3857 for retained DCAD sample; City of Dallas service metadata reports EPSG:2276

qualification.reason: The public DCAD TaxParcel2025 service provides a verified polygon-plus-OBJECTID response, but serial review must qualify canonical parcel semantics, coverage and adapter safety before runtime admission.

scopeLimits: DCAD is an appraisal-district parcel service, not evidence of a title/land-registry record.
One bounded exact-point query is not evidence of complete citywide coverage or absence outside the returned polygon.
The exact WUP point remains unchanged in latitude/longitude order; only request coordinates were transformed for the source CRS.
The retained GeoJSON has exactly one canonical native identity property and no raw source attribute set.
Owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate/title and mailing fields were not requested or retained.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS-verification exception was used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The public services establish a usable local/regional parcel response, but their parcel refresh, completeness and jurisdiction-boundary semantics were not independently established. The statewide Texas service was not queryable with the tested operation.
